offering_description.value: Veeva sells cloud software and data to pharmaceutical, biotechnology and medical device companies. Its subscription products help customers run clinical trials, manage regulatory submissions, quality and drug safety, and handle commercial operations.

primary_products.value: Clinical trial and data management software; regulatory and drug safety software; quality management software; customer relationship and commercial content management software; healthcare market data and analytics

primary_services.value: Software implementation and configuration; data migration and integration; business consulting; user training

customer_segment.value: B2B: Pharmaceutical companies, biotechnology firms, medical device manufacturers and contract research organizations

end_markets.value: Pharmaceuticals; biotechnology; medical devices; outsourced clinical research

revenue_model.value: subscription: Access to cloud applications, healthcare datasets and analytics; service fees: Implementation, integration, migration, consulting and training

value_chain_position.value: software / platform: Develops cloud applications and curates healthcare data for life sciences companies; service provider: Configures software and migrates customer data for life sciences organizations

geography_served.value: global: North America, Europe and Asia-Pacific

specialization.value: related lines: Clinical, regulatory, safety, quality and commercial applications, plus healthcare data and analytics

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: Enterprise sales teams serving life sciences companies and research organizations

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: Regulated workflows involve FDA electronic records requirements under 21 CFR Part 11 and privacy rules such as GDPR.

notes: The current scope of its quality software business outside life sciences is uncertain.
